column1: # Dated structural events for the WW2 v0 hindsight snapshots (see data/ww2/README.md).
# One row per event and variable: the level the variable takes from that date. Rows whose level
# equals the level already in force are dated confirming observations. A '?' in the source cell
# marks a date or reference recalled but not verified; the note says which.

column5: event
column6: source
column7: note
